reference_tables.intro: Listed here are all of the Valuables in the game, in the order that the game lists them.

cells: Engraved stone, it shows current Malice level

description.text: Glowing stone. A memento from father. When hero awakens as a Harmonixer, the light changes from blue to yellow to red and displays current Malice level.
This pendant was given by Father Elliot. In the train, it emits a powerful mystical light that rescues our hero.

cells: Rust-covered gear. Used in a sluice gate

description.title: Sluice Gate Handle
description.text: Once a part of a sluice gate, it is now completely rusted over. After the locals were killed in a war, the gate was left untended for ages.

cells: Smelly Chinese herb infused with catnip

description.text: This incredibly foul smelling medicine contains catnip. It smells foul but is a sure cure for cat troubles.

cells: Bundle of dried twigs. Used as a light source

description.text: Dried twigs that have been bundled together for easy use. Useful as an outdoor light source.

cells: Foul-smelling bowl once used by a pathologist.

description.text: Measuring bowl used by a pathologist in Zhaoyang Village. Bits of putrid, rotten flesh cling to the bottom.
Called the "Sealing Stone", it is a glowing blue gem used as a tool in the art of dark geomancy to create and strengthen barriers.

cells: Dried mackerel for the dedicated fish-lover.

description.text: Salt-dried mackerel. Bred in deep ocean currents, its meat is firm yet tender. A quack oracle ate 5 of them at Sea Turtle Restaurant. Everyone was disgusted.
Ancient token displaying one of the 5 Yin and Yang elements, wood. Used in opening mystical seals or barriers.

cells: Key to "Yawang Gate" leading to Kuihai Tower

description.text: Key to "Yawang Gate", the only entrance to Dehuai's fortress, Kuihai Tower. Obtained by Lieutenant Suketani at the cost of many of his followers' lives.

cells: Creepy key carved from some animal's bone

description.text: Key hand carved from the spine of some oddly shaped animal. What secret could this eerie key be hiding?

cells: Painting containing the power of the Blue Dragon

description.title: Blue Dragon Votive Picture
description.text: Mystic tool with the power of the Blue Dragon, one of the 4 gods of directions. In the hands of a wicked person, it alone could lay waster to an entire nation.

cells: Painting containing the power of the White Tiger

description.title: White Tiger Votive Picture
description.text: Mystic tool containing the power of the White Tiger. It has the power to lay waste to an entire nation. Taken from Kuihai Tower 15 years ago by Colonel Hyuga.

cells: Painting with the power of the Black Tortoise

description.title: Black Tortoise Votive Picture
description.text: Mystic tool with the power of the Black Tortoise, one of the gods of directions. In the hands of a wicked person, it alone could lay waste to an entire nation.

cells: Painting containing the power of the Red Phoenix

description.title: Red Phoenix Votive Picture
description.text: Mystic tool with the power of the Red Phoenix, one of the 4 gods of directions. In the hands of a wicked person, it alone could lay waste to an entire nation.

cells: Key to gate separating Bistritz and forest

description.text: Key to Bistritz town gate. If the gate is for protection from animals, why is there a carving of a sun on the gate and garlic on the key?

cells: Key for entering the orphans' room

description.text: Key found in a rather questionable orphanage. It opens the Orphans' Room (They called it the Key Room. Those jerks.)
Pure gold key from Joshua.
Key to Calios Mental Hospital. More prison than hospital, there is a dark side to its grand history.
Key to prison-like mental hospital. It is worn from the hands of the many cruel torturers who held it.
This key is for the sole purpose of locking unwanted people away from the rest of society in a prison euphemistically called a hospital.

cells: Hospital room key held by Viscount Rausan

description.text: Key jealously guarded by the hospital director, Viscount Rausan. It seems to have been polished obsessively and is without even a single scratch.

cells: Bronze coin from hospital. Oddly scratched.

description.text: Bronze coin with a crab spider symbol etched on it. Probably for some purpose other than money. Deeply scratched from use.

cells: Silver coin from hospital with bird symbol

description.text: Silver coin inscribed with symbol of the magical burn, Lopuros. Ancient and scarred from years of use.

cells: Gold coin from hospital with demonic crest

description.text: Ancient gold coin inscribed with a demonic crest. Thick and heavy, it shines out even in a dark hospital room.

cells: Platinum coin from hospital with dragon symbol

description.text: Platinum coin inscribed with the symbol of a dragon. It's impossible to tell whether it's new or old and it rings out with a lovely tone when plunked.

cells: Key carved from the bone of some animal.

description.text: Apparently a key to some huge door, it is stamped with the image of some god-like entity. Whether good or evil, it is impossible to tell.

cells: Letter from Doyle found in Penitence Room

description.text: Letter from Father Doyle found in the Penitence Room. Detailed within is a list of various sins that became privy to him in the confessional. NOTE: While you do get to read this during the game, it never actually makes it into your inventory.

cells: Grail from which Death drank souls

description.text: Death drunk on souls, told the Overlord how to beat the Four Masks. "Grail weakens Gold; Gold, Staff; Staff, Sword; and Sword, Drink. My oath is to the Grail..."

cells: Old key found near water-spitting lion

description.text: Extremely rusty key that doesn't look as if it has been well looked after.

cells: Discovered at the doll museum. I see something...

description.text: Slide found in dollhouse. The upper half of a young girl can be seen faintly. If I only I had a Projector...

cells: Card with a picture of a snake. Useful in shops.

description.text: Card from the Wholesale Items Guild (WIG). Gives various benefits. But if you lose on discount 5 times in a row with insufficient funds, it becomes inactive.

cells: Guild card from Shanghai with picture of star.

description.text: Card acquired from a fortune-telling boy in Shanghai. Very useful in shops. Don't leave home without it.

cells: Guild card with picture of moon. From Bistritz.

description.text: Guild card found in Bistritz. This one has a moon picture on it. Those guild folks must be astrology fans.

cells: Guild card with Sun picture. Bought in London

description.text: Guild card with picture of the Sun on it. I wonder why that person had it? London is a strange city. All that fog and everything...

cells: Slightly thicker. "Eternity" is written on it

description.text: Guild card acquired from a suspicious man. Makes one realize that just about anyone can be a guild member.

cells: Stone with same wavelength as Earth Tombstone

description.text: Oddly glowing stone. It gives off exactly the same wavelength as the one in the graveyard.

cells: Stone with same cold feeling as Water Tombstone

description.text: Strangely glowing stone. It emits the same cold feeling that I get in the graveyard.

cells: Stone with same qualities as the Air Tombstone

description.text: Strangely glowing stone. It gives off the same airy feeling that I get in the graveyard.

cells: Stone with same hotness as the Fire Tombstone

description.text: Strangely glowing stone. It gives off the same hot feeling that I get in the graveyard.

cells: Stone with same spirit as the Light Tombstone

description.text: Strangely glowing stone. It seems to have the same mystic qualities as the one in the graveyard.

cells: Stone with same evil spirit as Darkness Tombstone

description.title: Darkness Gravestone
description.text: Strangely glowing stone. It seems to have the same evil spirit as the one in the graveyard.

description.title: Stone of Destruction
description.text: Oddly shaped stone. It emits a strange power the likes of which cannot be felt anywhere else on earth or above.

cells: Ultra-mysterious stone found among the ruins

description.text: Made of a substance which seems to be somewhere between stone and metal. Is it light, heavy, hard, soft? Even touching it, it is impossible to tell.
Wh, what's this? The famous literary journal and pin-up magazine, "Shanghai Angels"! Why would that be such a valuable item? Maybe I'll find out in the future.

cells: Secret book of summoning the Other Gods.

description.text: Greatly sought after, this ancient tome is rumored to be a secret guide to summoning the "Other Gods".

cells: Strange old book with small hidden clues.

description.title: Book of Rituals (A)
description.text: Old book engraved with an image from Mt. Olympus. It says "The Memory Palace... Cross the rainbow, then follow the drops of blood to the royal garden".

description.title: Book of Rituals (B)
description.text: Old book engraved with an image from Mt. Olympus. It says "Controller of the rainbow. Go backwards like a devil. Follow the royal garden to the drops of blood".

cells: Ancient book. A bookmark is inside.

description.title: Emigre Manuscript (A)
description.text: Legendary manuscript written on a skull. On it is scribbled: "stone Temple.. Take the path of the left dragon...". The bookmark smells of violets.

cells: Legendary manuscript. Its fragrance has changed.

description.title: Emigre Manuscript (B)
description.text: Manuscript written on a skull. On it is scribbled: "Stone Temple... Take the path of the right dragon". The smell of violets has been replaced by tiger lilies.
Bacon's manuscript: "The rainbow's treasure is a golden moon, burning sun, old forest, royal garden, ocean's color, drops of blood and from the sky to rebirth".
